scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: Science of sizes! My robot is smaller than Luna, but Luna is faster than my robot. Data collected!
scene.intro: Science of sizes! Erik measures everything in the club house with a very long tape. My robot is smaller than Luna, he says, but Luna is faster than my robot. Valentina is taller than Mateo, this box is bigger than that one, and the old lamp is older than everybody in the room. Which is bigger, a whale or a bus? Compare two things near you and say it!

activities.title: Listen to the measuring day. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Erik (con la cinta métrica) y Valentina (anotando).
data.script: Erik: Measuring day! Valentina, you are one metre forty. … Valentina: And you are one metre thirty-eight. I'm taller than you! … Erik: Only by two centimetres! Now the jump test. … Valentina: Mateo jumped one metre — he's the best jumper. … Erik: And in the race, Sofia was faster than everyone. Eight seconds! … Valentina: What about Luna? … Erik: Luna is faster than Sofia. But she doesn't follow the rules — she starts before the whistle! … Valentina: Conclusion: everyone is the best at something!

Describe places, objects, past events; role-play simple situations.
Read and sequence short stories; locate information in signs, notices.
